description: Approve or turn down an option a voter suggested on a poll this chat made (it needs the manage key). Approved suggestions become options everyone can vote on. Check with the person before deciding for them.

approve.description: true adds it to the poll as an option; false turns it down. Either is final.

manageKey.description: The manage key create_poll returned for this poll.

poll.description: The poll's link (https://usepickly.com/p/…) or its id.

name: review_suggestion
title: Review a suggested option
